basic_info.description: Fantastic opportunity to own this Mid-Century fully detached corner family home in esteemed Lakeshore neighborhood. This 3BD/3BA home boasts period details, parquet floors, and abundant natural sunlight. Main level consists of an entry foyer, formal living room w/ center fireplace, formal dining room, a spacious updated eat-in kitchen and a full bathroom.  Upstairs has three generous sized bedrooms with hardwood floors and full bath. There is also a 2-car side by side garage with laundry area, bonus full bath and tons of extra storage that leads to a nice garden area. Seller is also including furniture if wanted. Great location! Steps from Sunset Blvd, Lakeshore Plaza, and Lake Merced, Close to Muni, Stonestown Galleria, Stern Grove, and Ocean Beach.
